major_cooldowns.name: Dancing Rune Weapon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown, then press Blood Boil and Marrowrend inside the window so every rune weapon copies Blood Plague and pads Bone Shield.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 49028 is the cast id seen in all 5 sampled parses; 81256 is the matching self aura and is what the buff-based checks read.

major_cooldowns.name: Reaper's Mark
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown and always just ahead of Dancing Rune Weapon, and spend your Exterminate charges before the mark detonates.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Deathbringer only. 439843 is the castable row, 434765 is the passive/talent row; neither shows in the sampled parses because the field played San'layn.

major_cooldowns.name: Consumption
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Empower it to rank 1 whenever Dancing Rune Weapon is not active, and to rank 3 the instant you exit Dancing Rune Weapon on multiple targets.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1263824 is the castable row, 1263825 is the passive row. Not pressed in the sampled parses, but the guide lists it as a button in every priority.

major_cooldowns.name: Raise Dead
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Resummon the ghoul off the global cooldown every time Raise Dead comes back up.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 46585 is the cast id seen in all 5 sampled parses; 46584 and 52150 share the name.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Shell
defensives.usage_rule: Press it into a magic hit so the damage is absorbed and turned into Runic Power.
defensives.id_note: 48707 is the cast id observed in all 5 parses; 444741 shares the name and is unused.

defensives.name: Anti-Magic Zone
defensives.usage_rule: Drop it under the group for a stacked magic hit that the raid has to eat.
defensives.id_note: 51052 is the cast id; 145629 is the aura of the same name.

defensives.name: Icebound Fortitude
defensives.usage_rule: Save it for the heaviest physical hit in the window, and use it to shrug off a stun.

defensives.name: Vampiric Blood
defensives.usage_rule: Press it whenever it is not already up so your Death Strikes land on a bigger health pool and heal for more.

defensives.name: Lichborne
defensives.usage_rule: Press it to break or ignore a charm, fear, or sleep effect.

defensives.name: Rune Tap
defensives.usage_rule: Weave a charge into predictable melee swings and do not sit on both charges.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip; 2 charges.

defensives.name: Tombstone
defensives.usage_rule: Cash in surplus Bone Shield charges for the absorb only when you are already deep into your bones.
defensives.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

defensives.name: Sacrificial Pact
defensives.usage_rule: Sacrifice the ghoul for an emergency heal when your other defensives are down.
defensives.id_note: 327574 is the Death Knight row; 175900 shares the name. Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip.

rules.description: Keep Bone Shield rolling at all times
rules.action: Press Marrowrend before Bone Shield runs low, or Death's Caress when you cannot reach the target.

rules.description: Keep Essence of the Blood Queen stacked
rules.action: Press Vampiric Strike before the buff runs out so the stacks carry into your next Dancing Rune Weapon.

rules.description: Blood Plague stays on your target
rules.action: Reapply it with Blood Boil, and land one inside Dancing Rune Weapon so each rune weapon adds its own copy.
Drop a fresh Death and Decay whenever the buff is down or Crimson Scourge procs, and fight inside it.

rules.description: Open Dancing Rune Weapon into Blood Boil
rules.action: Pre-place Death and Decay, then open Dancing Rune Weapon into Blood Boil before your first Vampiric Strikes and Death Strike.

rules.description: Death Strike before Runic Power caps
rules.action: Spend down with Death Strike instead of pressing another Heart Strike near the cap.

source_summary: Blood's only offensive cooldown outside its hero trees is Dancing Rune Weapon, sent on cooldown and immediately fed Blood Boil and Marrowrend so every rune weapon copies Blood Plague and refills Bone Shield. San'layn turns that window into Gift of the San'layn, where Vampiric Strike takes the filler slot and keeps Essence of the Blood Queen stacked between windows, while Deathbringer fires Reaper's Mark just ahead of Dancing Rune Weapon and spends its Exterminate charges before the mark detonates. Everything else is resource discipline: hold Bone Shield at five or more charges, fight inside Death and Decay, and Death Strike before Runic Power caps.
